title: Bind pooled R437 replica-indexed native requests and charge widened source codes
body:
[PR #3995](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3995) showed that the actual pooled R437 source cannot enter the retained replica-blind catalogue. This PR constructs the next missing interface: a full replica-indexed request table and native owner binding for all 903456 paid sites. **Partial source/compiler result; physical CALL/RETURN and supplier admission remain open.**

Every request key resolves back to its actual caller, including pooled absolute families and exactly-once IDLE enumeration. The explicit consumer API is `idle_identifiers(child, replica)`; the legacy IDLE table is unavailable. COPY retains the common private target and records its actual source chart. Fixed source handles reject omitted/stale/cross-prime/mismatched contexts, including an incorrect Specifications catalogue.

All 1235 actual charts have dyadic entries and determinant ±1. The all 288-call audit certifies 179802 same-family owner pairs by universally nonzero dyadic-unit entry witnesses, without replica symmetry. This yields separation for every odd prime and invertible common low; it is not an enumeration or execution of GL64. The full profile has 836928 MOVE, 2592 COPY and 63936 IDLE sites, rank mass 1808352, 400877 rank-2 requests and one rank-14 request. Ordered request digest: `29ad864c2a6a31ad15162b0165b4f047cf580d9f2c147aebcfccfd564ccbbc60`.

The finite source-code vocabulary grows 32-fold, adding exactly five bits at every fixed q (q=3: 6507→6512). The proof retains 379584 routes and 507456 family scans per low class and charges +5 per raw field, +5h per h-step Program, plus resulting chronological parking and consumer costs. Unresolved occurrence counts, physical tariffs, native/child source acceptance and global reserve are explicit unknowns. Four actual retained q=3 source specifications compile; their good/fallback status is recorded. No physical residual body, whole-volume caller, new kappa or frontier change is claimed.

Validation: standard-library registered normal/optimized replay, source authentication, ten negative controls and exact-byte publication checks; detailed evidence in VALIDATION.md. Same-session AI cross-review independently re-counted the literal pooled sites/profile/owner pairs, found two context-boundary omissions, and checked their fixes. This is not external human or formal-kernel acceptance.

Credit Rohan Arun's [PR #3959](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3959)/[PR #3958](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3958)/[PR #3939](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3939) for pooling and endpoint; ai-nanachi[PR #3647](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3647), Ali Romman[PR #1043](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1043), Sagar Thakrar[PR #3700](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3700)/[PR #2423](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2423) and the R437 lineage;[PR #3995](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3995) for absolute-owner emission/catalogue counterexample;[PR #3980](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3980) for the dyadic checker;[PR #3983](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3983) for chronological resource accounting; Nick Petalas[PR #2989](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2989) for earlier owner/compiler correspondence. The existing[PR #3959](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3959) local follow-up already establishes the first helper's permutation transport/common plan. Canonical physical/source credit includes zxv, David Arias, Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, ywz65, alephnan, Adam Gall, Ross Richardson and all retained notices. Chris R/Clear1nsight, substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

Explicit donor assignment refines independent-moment. Canonical main 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90 / revision 6 refreshed unchanged before publication. Current [PR #3995](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3995)/[PR #3959](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3959) comments, live R437 replica search, parent live open-body checks and local overlap procedure were inspected; broader closed/private/Discussion coverage remains partial. Shared claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3967#issuecomment-6263066320 . This package does not duplicate [PR #3995](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3995)'s emitted-IR proof or claim its packing improvement.


Final documentation head `92daee4bf12255efe4ae0102eeb5f72794bf9c57` passes exact 154-file package/input byte, declared source-history, metadata and whitespace checks. Scientific bytes are unchanged after the normal, optimized and read-only Git-free replays.
